title: Python 3.11 datetime.datetime.utcnow
text:
datetime.datetime.utcnow()
Return the current UTC date and time, with tzinfo None.

This is like now(), but returns the current UTC date and time, as a naive datetime object. An aware current UTC datetime can be obtained by calling datetime.now(timezone.utc).

title: Python 3.12 datetime.datetime.utcnow deprecation
text:
datetime.datetime.utcnow()
Return the current UTC date and time, with tzinfo None.

Deprecated since version 3.12: Use datetime.datetime.now() with UTC timezone instead: datetime.datetime.now(datetime.timezone.utc). Because naive datetime objects are treated by many datetime methods as local times, it is preferred to use aware datetimes to represent times in UTC.

title: Python 3.12 itertools.batched
text:
itertools.batched(iterable, n)
Batch data from the iterable into tuples of length n. The last batch may be shorter than n.

Roughly equivalent to looping through slices of an iterable. Added in version 3.12.

Example: list(batched('ABCDEFG', 3)) returns [('A', 'B', 'C'), ('D', 'E', 'F'), ('G',)].

title: GSA Federal Travel Regulation Per Diem Bulletin FY2023
text:
GSA Federal Travel Regulation Per Diem Bulletin FY2023.
Effective Dates: October 1, 2022 through September 30, 2023.

The standard continental United States (CONUS) lodging per diem rate for non-standard areas is $98 per night. The standard meals and incidental expenses (M&IE) per diem rate is $59 per day.

Travelers must itemize lodging expenses on expense vouchers. Receipts are mandatory for all lodging transactions regardless of the amount.

title: GSA Federal Travel Regulation Per Diem Bulletin FY2024
text:
GSA Federal Travel Regulation Per Diem Bulletin FY2024.
Effective Dates: October 1, 2023 through September 30, 2024.

The standard continental United States (CONUS) lodging per diem rate for non-standard areas is increased to $107 per night. The standard meals and incidental expenses (M&IE) per diem rate remains $59 per day.

This bulletin supersedes GSA Per Diem Bulletin FY2023 for all official travel occurring on or after October 1, 2023.

title: GSA Federal Travel Regulation POV Mileage Reimbursement Rates 2024
text:
GSA Privately Owned Vehicle (POV) Mileage Reimbursement Rates for Calendar Year 2024.
Effective Date: January 1, 2024.

When an official Government-owned automobile is not available, the reimbursement rate for official travel using a Privately Owned Automobile is $0.67 per mile.

If a Government-owned automobile is available but the employee elects to use a personal automobile, the reimbursement rate is reduced to $0.21 per mile.

title: Python 3.12 pathlib.Path.walk
text:
pathlib.Path.walk(top_down=True, on_error=None, follow_symlinks=False)
Produce file names in a directory tree by walking the tree either top-down or bottom-up.

For each directory in the directory tree rooted at self (including self), walk() yields a 3-tuple: (dirpath, dirnames, filenames).

Added in version 3.12.

title: GSA Federal Travel Regulation Meals and Incidental Expenses (M&IE) Breakdown FY2024
text:
GSA Federal Travel Regulation M&IE Breakdown FY2024.
Effective Dates: October 1, 2023 through September 30, 2024.

For the standard continental United States (CONUS) daily M&IE rate of $59, the individual meal amounts are: Breakfast $13, Lunch $15, Dinner $26, and Incidental Expenses $5.

On the first and last travel days of official travel, the reimbursement rate is 75 percent of the total M&IE rate, which equals $44.25. Incidental expenses cover fees and tips given to porters, baggage carriers, and hotel staff.
